thread:
Priya: FYI elysium-4b-q4a landed in staging and our onboarding evals show a precision drop on short intent prompts and new hallucination patterns on RAG-style examples. Not huge overall but non-trivial on high-SLA routes.
Ben: saw an uptick in false positives for dedupe too. looks like many short support prompts are being collapsed (fingerprint radius might be too big).
Oscar: interestingly the float baseline didn't show this. suspect quantization+tokenizer interaction. elysium switched to uax-normalizer v2 which changes whitespace around emojis and zero-width joiners.
Nina: label ops can run a focused microgolden. We have 4 annotators today; can do 200 samples (manual) if you hand over ids and labeling rubric.
Priya: ok plan suggestion:
1) rerun dedupe with smaller radius for short prompts and enable "emoji-aware" split
2) build a 200-sample microgolden stratified by intent-type (support, setup, reset), length (<=64, 65-256), and RAG vs non-RAG
3) run quant-calibration with per-layer clipping + kv-cache length = 1024, compare to float baseline
4) run embedding-recall sweep on the same sample set to see if retrieval drift caused hallucination
Can someone pick up (1)?
Ben: i'll take dedupe. I'll add a short-mode in the dedupe runner and export new fingerprints to s3://redwood-curation/elysium/q4a/fp-shortmode-v1/ by EOD. Patch will be in PR #823.
Priya: for (2) Nina can you produce the sample pack and labeler instructions? Need precise pass/fail rules: keep if intent preserved, fail if hallucinated facts or truncation. Also flag partial answers.
Nina: yes. I'll push a guidelines doc and a shortlist of 200 ids to the labeler queue. Template intro: 
- Task: does the model answer the ask? (Y/N)
- If N, choose reason: hallucination / truncation / wrong-intent / unsafe
- Severity: minor/major/blocker
I'll attach examples.
label-bot: Auto-eval: elysium-4b-q4a canary deployed at 1717614950. Canary run id 78421. Full metrics report: https://ci.redwood/canaries/elysium-4b-q4a/78421
Oscar: for (3) i'll run quant-cal with per-layer clipping and longer kv-cache. hypothesis: shorter cache and fused attention kernel causes early stop on long prompts. i'll log config in experiments/elysium/q4a/quant-run-202603.json
Priya: also we should run de-dup again with language/tokenizer-aware fingerprints. Oscar, can you dump token diffs for a few failing examples?
Oscar: sure. quick token diff command:
```
python tools/token_diff.py --model elysium-4b-q4a --examples s3://redwood-curation/elysium/q4a/failing_ids.json --out /tmp/token-diffs.json
```
I'll post output.
Ben: note on dedupe params: we'll use radius=0.65 for short <64, radius=0.8 for others, and enable "zwj_split=true". That should reduce collapse.
Nina: labellers will need context: include reference completion from float baseline + model output + retrieval trace for RAG cases. otherwise they can't judge hallucination.
Priya: good call. Nina, please include float baseline outputs in the queue.
Nina: done. pushing queue now. expected first batch complete in ~6 hours.
Ben: FP export done -> s3://redwood-curation/elysium/q4a/fp-shortmode-v1/ and PR open.
label-bot: Regression monitor: microgolden rule will trigger if precision delta > 5% or hallucination rate increase > 3% on SLA routes. Rule id: mg-rule-elysium-2026-03.
Priya: last piece: if microgolden flags regression we'll enable route-level fallback to elysium-4b-fp32 for affected customers and roll back canary traffic. I'll draft rollout in rollouts/elysium_fallback.yaml.
Oscar: i'll run the embedding-recall sweep once microgolden is labeled. putting job on queue now.
Priya: sync in 45m in #eng-ml to review first label batch. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
